description: Reads the current public status of a SignUpSheet.page sign-up sheet, date poll or group card from its share link: which slots are open or full, poll answers per option, or how many people have signed a card. Use it when the user asks how their sheet, poll or card is going. Takes the public share link (signupsheet.page/s/…); it never returns email addresses or other private details.

share_url.description: The public link, e.g. https://signupsheet.page/s/k3m9x2pq (an 8-character sheet id alone also works).

name: get_sheet_summary
title: Get sheet status
